item.title: David vs Goliaths: Singapore builds most accurate clock ever, leaves US and China in dust
item.description: A small Singaporean research team has beaten scientists in China and the United States to build the world’s most accurate atomic clock. The clock, built with a single ion of a rare earth metal element known as lutetium, is so precise that it would lose one second every 260 billion years – nearly 20 times the age of our universe. It is about four times as accurate as the previous record holder, a calcium-ion clock developed by a Chinese Academy of Sciences team in Wuhan, and also surpasses an... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: "Nuestro gobierno se ha convertido en una amenaza grave": la familia de Renee Good presenta una demanda por su muerte
item.description: La esposa y el hermano de la mujer que murió a manos de un agente de ICE durante la violenta operación antinmigración 'Metro Surge' en Minnesota presentaron una demanda en la que buscan resarcimiento por daños y perjuicios. En ella apuntan al Gobierno federal, el perpetrador Jonathan Ross, a la exsecretaria de Seguridad Nacional Kristi Noem y a dos de los arquitectos de la política migratoria de Trump, Stephen Miller y Tom Homan. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: AP
